questions.prompt: A family runs a 2000 W geyser, a 1000 W iron and a 100 W TV at the same time on a 230 V circuit with a 10 A fuse. What happens? Show your working.
questions.modelAnswer: Total power = 3100 W. Current I = P/V = 3100 ÷ 230 ≈ 13.5 A. This is more than the 10 A fuse rating, so the fuse melts (or the MCB trips) and the circuit is switched off to prevent the wires overheating. They should use a 15 A circuit for the geyser or not run them together.
rubric: Exceeds 10 A: fuse blows / MCB trips
